reviews.text: My 10 year old Maltese-Bichon-MiniPoo mix was a squealing bundle of fear but Dr. Dr. DeLaRosa and tech Anthony were pros at handling him.
Hi, Herbster. We appreciate the rating. So glad we could provide you with a positive experience at Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital!

Our dog can be quite anxious coming to the vet, but the staff is always amazing, especially our technician Emily, who was very patient and loving with our dog! They made sure she was comfortable and happy and explained the breakdown of all of the procedures and pricing before proceeding which we really appreciated!
Hi, Adriana. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

They took very good care of my dog even when he was anxious. They updated me every step of the way of the dental cleaning and provided an affordable option for an echocardiogram. Very kind people working there
Amazing vet! The vet tech Emily was so helpful and loving with our girl we can’t say enough! They’re awesome!!

I’ve been a client for almost 22 years @ Calusa’s Animal Hospital and since day one I have been taking all my pets including several cats and my sweet dog Bambi 🙏🏻❣️.
Dr. Woodby now retired is the most kind and caring veterinarian I’ve ever met.
Through the years his staff has changed but I do love specially one of them that  has been more like a friend to me and my four legged friends Mr. Lori Bryan another extraordinary human being . Loving and caring as well. 💚

Calusa is now under new management however the caring of the veterinarians and staff keeps on been fantastic ; another very kind person that has been working for a few years as well is Maria.

Thx for continuing to care so much in keeping our pets healthy to all the newer personnel @ the Clinic  like Dr. Maryanne and everyone else.
As long as I have pets I will continue to visit this amazing Clinic.
Thx for all your years of making me feel so welcome.
Roberto
Excellent service from the initial phone call to guidance to the room to the explanation and service. Thank you.

I brought my dog at 10am because she was not herself and had stopped eating and drinking water. She was lethargic.the Vet  did notice she had puss coming from her vulva but he did not think it was pyometra because he said usually  it’s a “copious amount of puss”. I lost time being there and ended up diagnosing her myself through ChatGPT but at 9pm.  Long story short my dog had open Pyometra a medical emergency that thankfully she lived but almost died. She needed emergent surgery. Thankfully I took her to another emergency hospital and although I told them what I thought she had they quickly came and with one single X-ray she was diagnosed and taken for surgery. I think this vet even though he didn’t know, the least he could have offered was an X-ray and taken it from there. His lack of experience is what made me leave. He didn’t know what to rule out and that for me was a sign of a poor clinician.
Dr. M. De La Rosa is an excellent vet. Receptionist Lorie and veterinarian staff are all very knowledgeable and accommodating.

UPDATE TO MY PREVIOUS POSITIVE REVIEW:

I am updating my original review because I want it to be clear that I am the same client who previously recommended Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital. Unfortunately, after today’s experience with my cat Rosie, that trust is gone.

I dropped Rosie off at 8:15 a.m. for a scheduled dental procedure. As instructed, she had been without food or water since the night before.

Around 11:00 a.m., technician Anthony called me and began discussing another patient’s account until I pointed out that he had the wrong client. This was extremely unprofessional and concerning.

At approximately 1:30 p.m., Dr. Soler called and told me he was running “a little late” and that Rosie was next. By 3:15 p.m., I still had no update, so I called myself—only to discover that Rosie’s procedure had not even been started.

I was transferred to the manager, who also seemed unaware of what was happening. She apologized and later called offering for me to pick Rosie up. After my cat had already spent essentially the entire day there fasting and waiting, I found that response completely inadequate. When I arrived to pick Rosie up, even the staff greeting me seemed unaware that her procedure had never taken place.

I understand that veterinary hospitals can have emergencies and delays. What I cannot understand is this level of poor communication and lack of consideration for an animal who had been fasting since the previous night. If they were that far behind, I should have been informed much earlier so I could make the appropriate decision for my cat.

The experience felt incredibly uncaring. Our pets cannot advocate for themselves, and I expect a veterinary hospital to put their welfare first. Instead, I left with the unfortunate impression that the business side of the practice takes priority over the individual animals waiting in their care.

Both Rosie and my other cat, Gilbert were patients here. After this experience, they have lost my trust and the business of both pets.

I previously recommended Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital. Based on what happened today, I can no longer do so.

We had such a great experience with Gilbert today! AJ and Emily were wonderful—so kind, patient, and gentle with him. It was Gilbert’s first nail clipping, and they made the whole experience go so smoothly. I really appreciated how comfortable and cared for they made him feel. Thank you, AJ and Emily, for taking such great care of our little Gilbert! 🐾❤️

Have been coming here for a few years now,  the service is excellent. The staff is great with our furry babies, Emily is very sweet, and gentle with pets.
I feel safe and confident bringing   my babies here.

Emily was kind and patient with our babies. We have been coming to Calusa Animal Hospital for years and would highly recommend them. They always take their time explaining care and procedures for our dogs.
Thank you so much for sharing your great experience with us, Cleo !

I have used Calusa Crossings for 10 Years. The service has always been excellent. The staff is very caring and provides great service. Dr De La Rosa was very knowledgeable and thorough. The staff is Great!
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Sarah! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital .

Lulu’s senior vet visit was great!
Dr. De La Rosa and her staff are knowledgeable, professional, kind and compassionate. I highly recommend Calusa Crossings Animal Hospital for all your pet medical needs.
Great place, everyone is  very friendly and eager to help. Our kitten Pixie is in great hands every time we visit.
Been going here for years, everyone is so kind and attentive and caring. Emily & AJ did a great job with my dog's bloodwork and nail trim. Thank you all!
Amazing service, very knowledgeable and pet friendly environment
Great staff and doctors. Have been bringing my 6 year old dog here since we first got her

The staff is very nice and professional and very understanding.  Everyone wants to help you and your fur baby.  The vet listens to my concerns and  discussed a plan of treatment.  The office texted me on how my cat was responding to the treatment.  I do recommend Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital to everyone who are looking for a vet.

We truly can’t say enough wonderful things about the care our two boys receive here.

AJ, the vet tech, is absolutely amazing… knowledgeable, compassionate, gentle, and incredibly thorough. She asks all the right questions and genuinely wants to make sure you leave with everything you need and that your pet is completely taken care of. Her calm, loving demeanor with our boys has made such a difference. They love her and, most importantly, they are not afraid to come to the vet.

Dr. Delarosa is equally amazing. She is incredibly knowledgeable, and her bedside manner with our boys is unlike anything we’ve ever experienced at a veterinary office. The minute they see her, their tails start wagging and the kisses begin! What I appreciate most is that she meets the animals where they are. Instead of placing them high up on an exam table where they may feel uncomfortable or scared, she gets right down on the floor with them. During our last visit, there were blankets on the floor, and one of our boys curled right up on one while Dr. Delarosa examined him. He was completely relaxed. That kind of compassionate care means everything to us.

We also recently had the pleasure of meeting Cynthia, the manager. This morning, we came in with one of our boys who was having a bit of a medical emergency, and Cynthia immediately took us in and got everything set up. You can tell that she genuinely cares about the practice, the patients, and the families who walk through the door.

I’ll admit, at one point we were concerned about the future of the practice because of the amount of turnover we had seen. But it truly feels like the ship has been righted. With AJ, Dr. Delarosa, and Cynthia at the helm, we feel incredibly comfortable knowing our boys’ veterinary care is in such capable, compassionate hands.

Thank you, ladies, for treating our boys like they’re your own. It means more to us than you know! ❤️
Have always taken our pets to Calusa Crossing. Personal service and compassion for the animal is adhered to in a very caring manner!
We came in for some hygiene things, a nail trim and glands. AJ, the tech that helped us, was amazing! Bear can be really nervous, but she was kind and patient. He was well taken care of!
I always bring my cats here and the staff and service is great !
Very professional and attentive to Olivia care condition at time of visit

I’ve been coming here for many years thru all of my past and current pets. There have been changes in doctors, but it’s still a wonderful clinic . Starting with the front desk and of course with Dr. de la Rosa, who has such a love for the pets, very genuine and heartfelt and AJ, who is magnificent, such great people person - great personality. One of the things I value was that they called me after my dog visit to check on her and to see how she was doing. That’s excellent Follow up and concern for your fur baby.

We had a wonderful experience at Pixie’s veterinary office! The staff was kind, caring, and very gentle with our little kitten. They took the time to answer all of our questions and made us feel comfortable and confident in her care. We truly appreciate everything they did for Pixie and highly recommend them! 🐱💕 …

Oh my goodness, the best doctor and staff! We had an emergency with one of our goats, Peach. Even though they don’t normally treat goats or other large animals, they kindly stepped in and helped us when we had nowhere else to go.

They went above and beyond to save her life, relieve her suffering, and give her the care she desperately needed. Their compassion, professionalism, and willingness to help meant the world to us.

We are so grateful and are hopeful that Peach will make a full recovery because of everything they did. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for giving her a chance.

You are truly amazing. God bless each and every one of you!
Excellent service and Dr. Marian was very knowledgeable and helpful!
This place is amazing the staff the doctors they treated us like family this was our first time visiting the clinic, we will definitely return thanks again! And the price is reasonable and fair…..
We’ve been coming to Calusa Animal Hospital for over a decade and love this place! They treat my pets with care and dignity.

UPDATE July 10, 2026
I have changed my rating -too bad I can't do no stars -because of my last experience the day before yesterday. First of all I want to say that is so sad that they don't have Dr Woodby anymore in the clinic. He was the best! ..efficient, confident, extremely knowledgeable like no other because of his vast experience no fuss, no extra test for no reason. We waited almost an hour and a half- I didn't see any other patients in the clinic so I have no idea why was the wait. I have to be honest they gave us the appointment right away because it was kind of an emergency my cat had UTI-Lori is amazing, helpful she always finds a way to help you. The experience was horrendous not  because of Dr De la Rosa  but a technician called AJ what it stands for Ashley Johnson she was the worst person I have ever encountered in any veterinary clinic. She talked over us,  she was making faces when we were talking about our cat telling them that no urinalysis was necessary. She insisted to get my Rufus in the back of the clinic to get an ultrasound guided urinalysis when we knew his bladder was empty, they said they fear crystals and they were looking for blockage how are you going to get to see crystals if you don't get any urine. I have worked in a lab for 27 years I know a thing or two about your urinalysis and laboratory testing.. I am surprised is the doctor De la Rosa seemed as she was relying on her opinion more than her own when they were checking Rufus. Finally I told them" listen we came here for you to check Rufus, we know what's going on with Rufus, I know you cannot dispense the prescription without checking him just give us the antibiotic and stop insisting and unnecessary test" . My husband was so frustrated that he said he was about to walk out and what AJ did ? She was handed him the carrier with Rufus and say okay you can go instead of trying to get things right. that was so rude and professional. We were worried and frustrated. She Ashley Johnson - talked down to us, was disrespectful and condescending. By the way I have a friend that have the same experience with her so this is an ongoing problem. They finally gave me the medicine Rufus is okay the only problem I see is the doctor De la Rosa never came back to even talk to us or straight things out.
I miss Dr. Woodby so much!!! he took in consideration and listen to the patients' parents, he gave you options, considering your opinion because he knew that you know your pet even though we always respected his diagnosis, he's the doctor and is extensive experience is like no other... however,he always respected your opinion, and we showed him the same respect. He never let a technician talked and argue with the patients ' parents when he was there, he was the doctor, not the technician.He was my vet for more than 28 years.
Needless to say, we're definitely not going back there. Apparently a lot of patients have the same sentiment. I remember when doctor Woodby was there the waiting room was full of patients, I have gone there -twice- the clinic is empty. That shows a lot.
Brought my cat in for soft paws application, and they did a very good job. Very satisfied with our visits.
Calusa Animal Hospital has a great staff, always very helpful. My dog has been coming here for years and has always gotten the best treatment.
The team is very professional and the  service is great. Thank you

We brought our senior dog Sunny to Calusa Crossing for the first time. He is a 13-year-old Australian Cattle Dog with serious conditions due to his advanced age.
We consulted with Dr. Victor Soler who did an amazing job with Sunny.
Dr. Soler is the best vet we have ever worked with in Sunny's life.
He is professional, detailed, trustworthy, and highly skilled.
Additionally, he has integrity and a true passion for veterinary medicine.
The facility itself is nice, clean, and organized.
The support staff are friendly, courteous, and attentive.
I would like to thank Emily (tech), Anthony (tech), and Linzey (receptionist). They made our experience even better by being so customer oriented and professional.
After our visit I received follow up call from the staff to see how Sunny was doing the next day, and then an in-depth phone consultation with Dr. Soler later that week to review the results of Sunny's diagnostic tests.
Now that all the test results are in, we have some decisions to make.
We are confident in Dr. Soler's recommendations, and Calusa Animal Hospital for Sunny's future care.
The staff at Calusa Crossing is a great team, and they work together very well.
Thank you and we look forward to returning with Sunny in the future.

Terry and Laura Svolto

At Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital.
The staff is very attentive, Treats my dog with compassionate care, and  are very efficient with their time.
Always appreciated. :)

Great staff!!!!  Great doctors!!!  It’s a very home  feeling!! My pup was neuter las week and so far everything has been smooth sailing !! He was feeling great the next day and so far his incision has been perfect!!! Thank you for taking such good care of our baby!!!!!!
I went in for a checkup on my cat and everyone here was super nice and welcoming. Dr. DeLaRosa was very good, polite, and friendly. Love this place very much !
Great professional, knowledgeable, and caring staff!

This place is grossly negligent and overpriced. I have never been to such a terrible establishment that overall seeks to take money from clients who are just trying seek help for their helpless pets. The vet is extremely unhelpful and never responds to clients unless they are called about 8,000 a day; and even then they still won’t actually help give your pet adequate care. I would never and will never bring my pets back here again.
They always work me in when I have an emergency for my pet and the text and doctors are very friendly and patient explaining details of diagnosis

Dr. Woodby  has been my vet for 30 years  he is an amazing  caring and honest  Doctor I wouldn't change him for the world , also his staff is top notch .   Just by the years I have been coming to Dr. Woodby I have to say no more , my whole family are animal lovers so he is the vet for all of them .
I’m so lucky to have him as our doctor .
Juana lledo

Took our dog Odie here today for the first time and are absolutely delighted with the kind of service we experienced. Doctor Solar and the staff were amazing. Very loving and caring to Odie and we were allowed to be with him through all his tests and exams. Definitely recommend this office for all your pet needs!

Our family has trusted Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital for over 15 years and truly wouldn’t have it any other way. They’ve been there for us through the happiest moments and some of the hardest ones too, always treating our babies like family.

The entire team is compassionate, honest, and genuinely cares. We’re so grateful for the love and support they’ve shown our family over the years. Thank you for always being there for us ❤️🐾
Best vet in the world we love the staff and the care is unmatched!!
They are a Great team Ashley and Dr Marian,  they are very sweet and professional with the pets.
Thank you for taking the time to rate us, Gloria! We are delighted that you had a great experience with Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital .
Outstanding experience every single time! Have been coming here since my dog was very young.
My dog has IMHA and we take her here every 3 weeks to get checked. Super nice and friendly staff!

Everyone here was amazing from making an appointment to the nurse to the actual vet . Made everything simple straight to the point no hidden fees just straight transparency and genuine care for my pet .
Long time client . The office is conveniently located with flexible hours. Dr del a rosa and AJ are always willing to help are two cats with friendly care and staff.
Bubba love every visit , so attentive and careful with him.

I’ve never been to this vet before but have driven by it several times. Unfortunately, I had a pet emergency and chose to stop in instead of going to my normal vet. This place is beyond friendly and welcoming. Every single person I encountered was extremely helpful and caring. My situation was not a pleasant one because I ended up losing my pet but let me tell you, this office and staff and forever won my heart with the caring and compassionate way they treated my pet and I. I do have other pets at home and will be switching over to this office permanently.
Forever grateful - Luna’s mom

10/10 recommend this vet! Dr. Marian De La Rosa and Vet Tech Anthony are amazing. They’re honest, straightforward, and don’t try to overcharge or push unnecessary services, which is rare to find. Teddy loves them too!

I recently took my cat, Princess, to Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital, the best place to take my pets. Princess had a previous UTI, which she recovered from. However, a week later, she stopped eating and pooping. I rushed her to Calusa Animal Hospital, where Dr. Mariana de la Rosa performed a thorough examination and blood work. Everything appeared within normal range and she was discharged with medication to treat an infection.

At home, Princess ate some but not enough and continued to have constipation despite the medication. Giving her the medication was a difficult ordeal. Princess was 21 years old, and I couldn’t bear the thought of her enduring any more suffering. After much contemplation, I decided to put her to sleep because she was in pain.

Throughout the entire euthanasia process, Dr. De la Rosa, the techs, and Lori were incredibly wonderful and compassionate. They took the time to wait until I was composed enough to continue the process, even though my heart was shattered by this experience. I want to express my deepest gratitude for their exceptional care and attention to my beloved Princess.

I wholeheartedly recommend Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital for all your pet care needs.
Great vet!!

Dr. Mary DeLarosa is awesome!! She took excellent care of our fur baby diagnosing him quickly & delivering instant relief to him with tenderness & compassion. Dr. Delarosa was also very mindful of the costs & worked with us to keep it at a minimum without sacrificing care. In addition the staff at Calusa is secondary to none! The tech James & the receptionist Lori are so loving & genuinely care.

I’ve had an excellent experience here at Calusa Animal Crossing. I really trust them with my puppy and I’m so grateful they listen and really make me feel like they care about me and my puppy. They are also very good at helping me understand what I need to do to keep my puppy healthy which is super helpful as a new puppy owner. They also don’t try to sell me 1001 things. They help me with costs and I appreciate that a lot as a college student.

I enjoyed meeting Dr de la Rosa and Ashley at the clinic. The doctor did a thorough exam of my fur baby and I was able to ask 1 million questions without feeling rushed at all. ( new mom).  I recommend them

Me, my boys and my wallet caught the good good vibes here!! My dad recommended me calusa when I first went down the rabbit hole of becoming a fur mom. Between the cat network and calusa my boys get all their needs met without losing a financial limb. The staff is cool calm collected and the vet is thorough and detailed oriented and everyone is so great with my boys!!!
Very good service. I felt they genuinely cared. Everyone was very nice, helpful and welcoming. The vet was great! He explained everything thoroughly.

Absolutely the best vet ever! Been going here for years and they have treated all our animals from generations, just moved and I travel down just for their annual visits 🤍 will never change vets! 10/10!!! Wish I can give them more than 5 stars!
I’ve been bringing my dog here for 4 years and always have a great experience! The staff is kind, professional, and truly cares about the animals. Highly recommend 🐶 …

They are all amazing, from the moment making appointment, and on my appt day the whole staff was very attentive and answered all questions and concerns being that this was the first time my Fur baby had 7 puppies. Dr. De La Rosa was incredible and her assistant took their time with every single one of them. Very responsive in returning calls. Thank you.

We’ve been bringing our dog Walter to Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital for over 10 years and have always had a great experience. The staff is incredibly friendly, caring, and professional. They’ve taken amazing care of our French bulldog every visit. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for a vet you can trust!

Doctor and staff are always professional and caring. Dr. DeLaRosa was thorough, friendly and kind. Paloma was sweet and attentive. I loved the fact that they called me the next day to check on my baby 🐾 …
Always professional with great service.
This place is amazing. Been here for a long time.

I've enjoyed the great service and attention my pet gets from Calusa. I've made them it's primary hospital. I trust the specialist at this location, they show that they care and they do their best to help my pet with his health issues. Thank you

Highly recommend. I had a wonderful first experience with this veterinary office. I found a newborn kitten abandoned in a parking lot and didn’t know how to care for it. Calusa Crossings animal hospital helped put my mind at ease and gave me guidance on how to care for the baby kitty. I was even able to get a Saturday appt with no issues. I tried going to Banfield first, but they left me sitting for an hour and a half, and then told me they couldn’t help me and to take the cat back to where I found it. It would have died! Thankfully I found Calusa Crossings.
Staff was friendly and kind to my dog

Best vet office ever ! Aj and Marian were so patient with my dog and very informative. They were able to calm my dog like no other vet could . I definitely recommend going here. I was also in and out very quickly

If I could give negative stars , I would. Horrible service. The technician that saw my moms fur baby , Penelope or Patricia (Can’t remember her name) made her feel like she was in a hurry and made her feel like her time wasn’t good enough. The doctor was good. But the technician however my mom said it felt like she didn’t care and wanted to go home.
My mom is old so she can’t do stuff on her own anymore and I told her to go to the Vet 1. to get out of the house and 2. So her baby can get checked out. When she called me almost crying about how rudely she was treated , it hurt me. I don’t know what happened to this clinic and the staff but it’s gone down since Dr Woodby left. Everything was super expensive so she declined most stuff. I did however find a more affordable place that doesn’t make you feel like your time is not wanted. I DO NOT RECOMMEND COMING HERE.
Excellent service great pricing
Always a great experience at Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital. Dr Marian De La Rosa is extremely knowledgeable, caring and dedicated to our furry babies. Champy was one happy doggie.
We had a great experience with this veterinary office. It has been great. The best thing was the time we spend waiting. I recommend them.
Excellent doctor’s. Highly recommend
The vets at Calusa Crossings Animal Hospital are the best. They are compassionate, sensible and treat my fur babies like family.
Excellent care . We are very happy with the doctor and his staff .

Unfortunately I will not be going back. I have gone to Dr. Woodby for 30 years and he sold his practice. Took my 5lb dog for a nail trim and was charged $68! What used to be $22, they have nerve. Plus she chews all but one toe nail so it only was 11 nails. They only care about money, not trust and care of their patients.

Just a tad disappointed that I was sitting in a room over 30 minutes after I was early for my fur baby’s appointment. Great, we were called on time, 1700! Vet examined my girl in 10 min and she was great!
I understand it gets busy, but my time is important too. This is my second fur baby in this practice. I continue with Calussa Crossing because of the attention and care the staff and doctors provide. I’ve been with you guys since 2009!
You made it right today and for that I’m grateful.

Thank you Ashley, you are very kind. Thank you Doc.

See you in April for Penni’s  rabies 3-yr rabies vaccine

Gratitude
Dee
Dr. De La Rosa is an exceptional and professional veterinarian. I’m very happy and satisfied with the care she provided to my babies when she have a fractured leg
I'm very satisfied with the care my cat received; I highly recommend them. The staff is very friendly and qualified!

I can’t believe Dr. Woodby is retiring but I know is time. My Osso and Bella are greatly appreciated for all these 12 years under his care. We hope to find someone with such integrity and understanding. thank you for all you did.

My dog had an IVDD flare up and they immediately treated her with the appropriate meds to help. They didn’t rush the appointment and thoroughly examined her. I’m very happy using Calusa Animal Hospital as my vet for both my dogs.

I had the best experience. I was in town vacationing when my dog was attacked. I call this location and they were able to get me in. They took amazing care of my dog and me. They were very kind, from the receptionist to the nurses and vet. The vet was knowledgeable and helped treat my dog quickly. I was given a free first visit, and they didn’t try to over charge me for things that my dog didn’t need. I would recommend this place to anyone!
Great staff, great price and the vet along with their staff truly love animals.  It was an easy transition for both my dogs.
Hi, Ana. Great to hear that you had a good experience at Calusa Crossing Animal Hospital. We really appreciate you taking the time to share!

I had to bring my senior chihuahua today in to be euthanized. Never in my life did I think I would have to but it was necessary. Not only did they squeeze me in, the treatment I was provided was amazing. From Maria at the front being an absolute sweetheart, to the assistant and vet being extremely compassionate . Although my heart is heavy, thanks to these amazing people it went super smoothly.

During the thanksgiving holiday weekend I brought my Frenchie in to be examined for a possible ear infection. Our vet was closed for the weekend and my dog was miserable. The staff at Calusa were so friendly and helpful. Selene (my dog) felt right at home and loved the attention. I recommend this vet.
Thanks Dr Ben for your kindness and professionalism

Great Vet Hospital.   We took our two cats there for their first annual checkup.   The attention was careful and loving.   The Vet and staff handled our cats with loving care.  Each step of treatment plan was explained and our cats were treated very well.

My cats have been patients of Calusa Crossings Animal Hospital for over 20 years. I have always been very happy with the professionalism of the staff and the care of my pets. This year I met Dr. Ben and Dr. Marian. Both have been very loving and caring with my kitty. Dr. Ben recently treated my kitty. He was not only thorough and considerate but he called me the next day to see how she was doing! I was impressed. Lori Bryan at the front desk is caring, knowledgeable, and always addresses my concerns patiently. Thanks to everyone at Calusa Crossings Animal Hospital my pets have thrived.
Staff are just as amazing as the doctors. Wouldn't trust anyone else with my babies. I'm so pleased  with Dr. De la Rosa and my fur babies love her.  Highly recommend this animal hospital!
Everyone was very professional  and my experience was Excellent!

Love Dr. Ben and love that they are now open on Sundays, however, the prices have increased so much since Dr. Woodby left that I am probably going to have to find a new vet. It is astronomical how much they charge and I believe they are padding the bill with stuff you don’t even need. Thank goodness the techs review the estimate prior to treatment so you can remove items if needed.

The “Free first time visit” advertised on Google wasn’t free, it’s 70$. Was told that proportion was to bring in new customers, since the previous veterinaries are no longer working there. But since I’ve been a customer there before (customer of over 25 years), I couldn’t get the promotion!  Even though it’s a brand new pet, and I would be seeing a new vet I’ve never met before. After hearing the price I said I would just go somewhere else and no one batted an eyelash. They’ve really missed the plot!  If you’re trying to bring in new customers becasue your new vets are strangers, maybe focus on keeping your lifelong loyal customers as well.

Such a bad costumer service. I called because I wanted my cat to have his first visit there and I was asking questions about services. The associate was not any help at all. I felt like she was throwing me off and she just didn’t want to assist me effectively. Such costumer service made me look for another place to take my pets.

Although my cat is old enough for a vaccine they asked me to return in a month to pay for $69 appointment. Otherwise very informative and kind on my first free visit. And dewormer medication was only $19

Our experience with Calusa Animal Hospital was great— we would like to thank Cathy for helping us with our Romeo. With him getting sick right before a trip we had the following day and their desire to accommodate him for our peace of mind is appreciated! They made it possible for us to take him in that same morning and did what they do best— treat him and make him feel better. And us, more at ease. Thank you for everything ;-)

I will not be returning to this facility, after bringing my dog here monthly for several years, for nail trim and anal gland expression. $103 is ridiculous!! They now charge an extra fee for the technician's time. How very sad. This used to be such a wonderful and caring spot.

It's a horrible shame what has happened to this place since Dr. Woodby left. Not only has the service gone down, but the costs have gone up dramatically. I had taken my dog in for a checkup. I was the first & only person in the office for a 9:00 AM appointment. The check-in counter was unattended when I arrived. When someone finally showed up to check us in. I was told to wait, and the vet would be right with us. Twenty-five minutes later, and while overhearing the vet on a personal call, I asked the young lady at the desk if the vet was available. She told me that he is with another patient and I would have to wait. I told her that I could hear him on the phone on a personal call. She basically dismissed my statement and told me to wait. I left. A couple of weeks later, while I was out of town, my mom took my small dog (she's 5 pounds) in for a nail trim that previously cost $20 - now it costs $35 PLUS a $15 Vet Tech fee. Totaling $53 (with tax), I'm presuming they don't pay their Vet Techs and rely on customers to pay additional fees to cover their wages. I brought my 12-year-old dog to Calusa Animal Crossing, where we saw Dr. Vasallo, because I noticed a growth near his eye. From the start, Dr. Vasallo took a doom-and-gloom approach. Without much examination, he told me it was likely a tumor and said he wasn’t comfortable treating it — he’d refer me to a specialist. He mentioned possibly prescribing eyedrops but quickly started piling on additional treatments that made no sense.
He insisted my dog had an ear infection and was “itchy,” even though I explained clearly that he hasn’t shown any signs of discomfort — no scratching, no head shaking, nothing. Dr. Vasallo dismissed my input and told me I simply wasn’t noticing it. He also made a comment that my dog “wasn’t easy” and that I needed to be cautious — which felt completely unfair. My dog is incredibly sweet, just understandably nervous in a vet setting. Instead of showing compassion, Dr. Vasallo made me feel like my dog was a burden.
Then came the pricing: it took an extremely long time to get an itemized list, during which my dog became increasingly anxious. When they finally brought it, the estimate was over $700 — for eyedrops, eardrops, a shot for itching (that my dog didn’t have), and the exam fee. I told them I couldn’t afford that and didn’t agree with most of what was recommended. We finally settled on the eyedrops, eardrops, and the $70 exam fee. Even getting those items and checking out took forever. We had to ask multiple times, and my dog was stressed to the point of trembling by the time we could leave.
Here’s the real kicker: I took my dog to a different vet shortly after, and the experience was completely different. The staff was kind and gentle. The vet was calm and thorough — and he confirmed that while the eye growth is a tumor, it’s small and very easy to remove under local anesthesia. He explained that these often start as styes and are very manageable — no specialist required. Oh, and the total cost? Much lower than what Calusa quoted — and with far better care.
In hindsight, I feel completely taken advantage of by Dr. Vasallo and Calusa Animal Crossing. I walked out $200+ poorer with nothing but stress and confusion — and my dog walked out more anxious than ever. I wouldn’t recommend this clinic to anyone who genuinely cares about their pet’s well-being.
